$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A credit card: the old profile's credit-card (a card core plus an optional security code). The validity is the record's own expiry date. A bank card has no security code: see bank-card.
title: Credit card
description: A credit card: its number, holder, issuer, PIN and security code.

cardholder.description: The name printed on the card.

issuer.description: The bank or company that issued the card.

issuer_phone.description: The issuer's phone number, for example the blocking hotline.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid: here, the card's expiry day. Empty means it does not expire.

allOf.description: A card has an expiry date.
